article.content: Club says AFL forward returned ‘positive preliminary test indication’ NSW police issue a notice for driving with a suspended licence The Sydney Swans forward Tom Papley has allegedly returned a positive preliminary drug test after being pulled over by New South Wales police on Monday. The 30-year-old was stopped by police for a roadside licence check which led to a court attendance notice for driving with a suspended licence as well as a random drug test. Continue reading...
